title: CablingAndAccessoryCatalogEntry
description: Standardized schema for structured cabling, surge suppressors, building entrance terminals, and mounting hardware in NetSelect Enterprise

standard.description: Cabling medium standard (DRC Rule 13 prohibits Cat6 for 10GBASE-T; mandates Cat6A)

rating.description: Jacket fire and environmental rating (DRC Rule 9 strictly prohibits CMP/CMR in underground or wet exterior conduit)

poeStandard.description: If surge protector: Highest certified PoE standard. DRC Rule 12 mandates 802.3bt-certified suppressors for high-power PTZ/outdoor cameras.

poeWattsMax.description: Maximum continuous PoE wattage pass-through without clamping (e.g. 30W, 60W, 90W)

groundWire.description: Ground bonding conductor size (TOW Cabling p. 5 and Life Safety Power p. 2 mandate #10 AWG stranded green copper to TGB)

matingHardware.description: Compatible camera models or mounting host IDs
